name: Yosr Ziadi
abstract_title: COST-EFFECTIVENESS OF PSILOCYBIN-ASSISTED THERAPY VERSUS STANDARD OF CARE FOR PATIENTS WITH TREATMENT-RESISTANT DEPRESSION
abstract: Background: Patients with treatment-resistant depression (TRD) experience high relapse rates and a relentless cycle of ineffective treatments, significantly impairing their quality of life and burdening healthcare resources. Psilocybin has emerged as a promising alternative, offering rapid and sustained symptom relief. However, its cost-effectiveness remains unexplored.
